name: Herm's Inn (Logan, UT) Famous Giant Cinnamon Swirl Pancakes (Cream Cheese Glaze)
whyItWorks: Herm's Inn is famous across Cache Valley for their enormous, plate-sized scratch pancakes. Completely seed-free and tender. Split one pancake with a partner to manage the sugar load.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order one Cinnamon Swirl Pancake to share; request cream cheese glaze on the side so you can drizzle lightly.
watchOuts: High sugar and rich cream cheese frosting; share portion to avoid sugar spikes
